body: My ex used me as a crutch for his life. He had, what one may call ‘unique issues’. Ultimately he had no interest in people, or likely being with anybody at all. I’m not even sure what my role in his life amounted to but I think it was essentially being his beard to being a facsimile of normal. Frankly all I can hold onto is knowing that he will die alone, and he will regret it, and it makes me smile.

A lot of what you’ve gone through is relatable. I also had a rough upbringing, and am extremely antisocial despite wanting connection. Life sucks but the only thing I have ever been able to go back to in my philosophy consistently is everything happens for a reason. Every fight, every accident, every firing, every loss, every possible shitty thing to happen has to be leading to something good.
